qualification.limitation: Do not infer general contributor ordering, overlapping picks, Connected Color, Fill or browser correctness from this candidate.

pinEvidence.identity: Automated consistency pin of predeclared independent expectations and retained actual native byte observations.

limitations: This additive manifest does not change the original fixture, trace or manifest.
Geometric filter queries are center predicates with declared options; they are not a composited GPU query or cache qualification.
Ordinary Color amendments are unconnected. Connected Color, Fill, overlapping contributors and actual GPU pick comparisons remain pending.
Native process exit was joined by the actual command terminal; no browser/physical-memory retirement or measured timing is established.
The full performance protocol, thresholds, cold/warm cache ownership, projected overdraw, sustained retention and supported capacity remain unqualified.
